transformations: Census API, HS10 7403110000, general imports: GEN_QY1_MO (kg) and GEN_VAL_MO (customs value, US$), one request per year
Country groupings (EU, regions) excluded; origins with no imports in the month omitted
Checked that every month has a total and that the origins add up to it exactly
Values kept as published; tonnes, shares and changes on the site are calculated from them

notes: General imports: all goods entering the United States, including into bonded warehouses and foreign-trade zones.
Customs value: the price paid or payable, excluding US duties, freight, insurance and other charges of bringing the goods to the United States.
Recent months are revised by the Census Bureau, usually in the annual revision each June.
